acceptanceCriteria.scenario: User logs in with valid credentials
acceptanceCriteria.when: User submits correct email and password
acceptanceCriteria.then: System returns a JWT token and user info

acceptanceCriteria.when: User clicks 'New Workflow' and fills in name
acceptanceCriteria.then: A draft workflow is created with a trigger node

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: User adds a node to a workflow
acceptanceCriteria.given: User has a draft workflow open in the editor
acceptanceCriteria.when: User drags a node from the palette onto the canvas
acceptanceCriteria.then: The node appears on the canvas and can be configured

acceptanceCriteria.given: User has a draft workflow with at least one trigger and one action
acceptanceCriteria.then: Workflow status changes to 'active' and executions start

acceptanceCriteria.scenario: User generates a workflow using AI
acceptanceCriteria.given: User is on the AI generator modal
acceptanceCriteria.when: User enters a description and clicks 'Generate'
acceptanceCriteria.then: System displays a workflow draft with nodes and connections
